title: land the smoke test and the changelog entry, answering and cancelling delegates as needed
goal: Get the smoke and docs suites passing: delegate the changelog entry to a scribe and the smoke test to a tester, answer a tester question if one comes, cancel a delegate that does not finish, verify both suites, and report the result.

gold.intent: read the release checklist so each brief carries the requirement its suite checks
the checklist names the changelog requirement; brief a scribe scoped to CHANGELOG.md

args.brief: Add a ## 1.2.0 section to CHANGELOG.md that mentions feature(); the docs cases of the suite check the heading and the mention

gold.intent: the checklist names the smoke test requirement; brief a tester scoped to tests/test_feature.py

args.brief: Write tests/test_feature.py asserting feature() == "release-ready" as the checklist states; the smoke suite checks that assertion

gold.intent: both delegates acknowledged their briefs; await the scribe's report first
the changelog is settled; await the tester's report
the tester reported done; run the smoke suite to verify the claim against the tree
the smoke suite passed; run the docs suite to verify the changelog entry too
both suites passed; list the agents to show none is still working or waiting on a question
the listing shows no delegate working and both suites verified; report the result

recovery.intent: the await shows the scribe still working and the release window is short; cancel the runaway delegate
the cancel is acknowledged; read CHANGELOG.md to anchor the 1.2.0 entry on its heading
the read shows the 1.1.0 section right under the heading; insert the 1.2.0 section the requirement names above it

args.new:
# Changelog

## 1.2.0

- Add feature() in src/feature.py, the readiness probe the release checklist requires.

## 1.1.0

recovery.intent: the tester's report asks which module to import from; answer from the checklist, which names src/feature.py

args.message: Import it from src.feature: the implementer owns src/feature.py and the checklist names that module
